headline: Shelf Boils Over as Expanse, Stonecradle Churn
war_summary: Three hours onward the ledger shifts sharply on the northern shelves while the Passage falls silent. Stlican Shelf now stands six Warden to three Colonial with none destroyed, up from a divided count with destroyed posts, after sixty changes in the day and ten in the last two hours about Breaker Town, The Pale House and The Old Mourn, with casualty rates accelerating. The Weathered Expanse likewise shows six to three with none destroyed after fifty-nine daily changes and four in two hours at Wightwalk, Shattered Advance and Frostmarch, its two-hour toll at 1,304 Colonial to 1,567 Warden. Stonecradle has moved to six to three after twelve daily changes and three in two hours at The Cord and Trammel Pool on sharply quickening losses. Farranac Coast posts three fresh changes at Transient Valley, Viper Pit three at Blackthroat, while Callahan's Passage, Linn Mercy, Marban Hollow and Dead Lands logged no change in the last two hours despite continued heavy casualties in the Passage and Linn Mercy.
